name: Music
desc: Generate a score cue. Fast enough to try five and keep one.

fields.label: Start from a cue
fields.hint: Picking one fills the three fields below; change any of them afterwards.

fields.label: Instrumentation and mood
fields.default: sparse melancholy piano, single sustained cello, restrained, instrumental
fields.hint: Name instruments and playing style, not feelings. Always end 'instrumental' unless you want singing.

fields.label: BPM
fields.hint: 0 means unmetered - do not try to cut to it.

fields.label: Seconds
fields.hint: Generate LONGER than the picture needs and trim in. ACE-Step has no hit-point conditioning and cannot spot to a cut.

note: cfg 1.0 is CORRECT here and not a mistake - ACE-Step 1.5 turbo is a distilled model. A listening test preferred it over the larger v1 3.5B.
